Prime Hardware MDS300U15 3 Inch Magnetic Door Stops

text.description_html:
Prime Hardware MDS300U15, 3" Satin Nickel Magnetic Door Stop and Holder

There are 2 main sections to this magnetic door stop. The 3" long base section has a permanent magnet on the end. You can vertically mount the base section to the floor or horizontally mount it to the wall or baseboard. The small round spring loaded receptor section is screwed to the door. Both sections of the magnetic door stop offer concealed screw mounting for an elegant installation. It is packaged complete with mounting anchors and screws for easy installation. The 3 Inch Magnetic Door Stop is made of zinc alloy and finished in Satin Nickel.

Also Available: Prime Hardware Magnetic Door Stops

Specifications of the MDS300U15 Magnetic Door Stop:

  • Material: Zinc Alloy
  • Height: 3"
  • Base Bottom Diameter: 1-3/4"
  • Top Diameter: 3/4"
  • Receptor Height: 7/8"
  • Receptor Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Packaged with mounting hardware.
  • Finish: Satin Nickel

Sold Individually
